name: Oxford PV perovskite-on-silicon tandem line, Brandenburg an der Havel, Germany
description: world's first commercial shipment of perovskite-tandem solar modules to a customer (5 Sep 2024); production modules 24.5% efficiency (up to 20% more energy than silicon); record 28.6% commercial-size cell (2024)
